events.evidence: A massive suicide car-bomb kills 70 Iraqi civilians in an attack near a police station in the city of Baquba, north of Baghdad
Traces of ricin are found in jars of baby food in a supermarket in Irvine, California.
A United Airlines flight carrying 246 passengers to Los Angeles, US, is forced to return to Sydney, Australia, after a bomb threat.

label.note: Iraq violence and a ricin scare keep risk appetite cautious.
